# `kernel/arch/tahoe/if` — architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — tahoe/if

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — tahoe/if.

`config.mk` records 4 source file(s) here: `if_ace.c`, `if_enp.c`, `if_ex.c`, `if_vba.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.

## 中文

本目录包含4.5BSD 内核的机器相关代码 — tahoe/if。

`config.mk` 记录了 4 个源文件：`if_ace.c`、`if_enp.c`、`if_ex.c`、`if_vba.c`。

这些 `config.mk` 清单来自 4.5BSD 源码树，是参考元数据；BSD45 的构建脚本（`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`）会显式选择实际参与编译的文件。
